# Python Documentation

> Comprehensive official documentation for Python programming language across all versions, including language reference, standard library, C API, and tutorials.

docs.python.org is the authoritative source for Python language documentation maintained by the Python Software Foundation. It provides complete API references, language guides, and C/C++ integration documentation across current and legacy Python versions from 2.6 through 3.15.

## Key Topics

- Python
- CPython
- Standard Library
- Language Reference
- API Reference
- C/C++ API
- Python/C API
- Tutorial
- Library Reference
- Official Documentation
- Getting Started
- Reference Guide
- Installation Guide
- Legacy Versions
- PyPI

## Current Python Versions

- [Python 3.15.0a7 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.15): Official Python 3.15.0a7 documentation with tutorials and API references.
- [Python 3.14.3 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.14): Official Python 3.14.3 documentation covering language and standard library.
- [Python 3.13.12 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.13): Official Python 3.13.12 documentation with C API and language reference.
- [Python 3.12.13 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.12): Official Python 3.12.13 documentation with C API and language reference.
- [Python 3.11.15 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.11): Official Python 3.11.15 documentation with C API extension support.
- [Python 3.10.20 Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3.10): Official Python 3.10.20 documentation with complete API reference.

## Reference & Navigation

- [Documentation Index](https://docs.python.org/3/genindex.html): Alphabetical index of Python 3.14.3 documentation terms and references.
- [Download Documentation](https://docs.python.org/3/download.html): Download Python documentation in various archive formats for offline use.
